overview.description: The ARK DIET Q2 Buffer ETF (ARKI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund is actively managed and seeks to deliver a defined outcome linked to the ARK Disruptive Innovation ETF (ARKK). The fund aims to absorb roughly half of ARKKs downside while capturing gains above a 5% hurdle, over a 12-month period starting each April. ARKI was launched on Apr 1, 2026 and is issued by ARK.
